{
  "decision-paired-lot-award-with-bay-cap": "WITH feasible AS (
  SELECT b.window_id, b.rule_source, f.offer_source AS frame_source, p.offer_source AS panel_source,
         f.price_cents + p.price_cents + b.fee_cents * CASE WHEN f.carrier_code = p.carrier_code THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS delivered_cents
  FROM bay_addendum AS b
  JOIN lot_offer AS f ON f.lot_code = 'frame'
  JOIN lot_offer AS p ON p.lot_code = 'panel'
  WHERE f.pallet_qty + p.pallet_qty <= b.pallet_cap
), ranked AS (
  SELECT feasible.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY window_id ORDER BY delivered_cents, frame_source COLLATE BINARY, panel_source COLLATE BINARY) AS position
  FROM feasible
)
SELECT window_id, rule_source, frame_source, panel_source, delivered_cents
FROM ranked
WHERE position = 1
ORDER BY window_id COLLATE BINARY",
  "decision-paired-map-packet-acquisition": "SELECT a.quote_id AS first_quote, b.quote_id AS second_quote,
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.design_code) FROM packet_sheet AS s WHERE s.quote_id IN (a.quote_id, b.quote_id)) AS new_designs,
       a.price_cents + b.price_cents AS total_cents
FROM packet_quote AS a
JOIN packet_quote AS b ON a.quote_id COLLATE BINARY < b.quote_id
WHERE a.price_cents + b.price_cents <= 1000 AND a.slot_count + b.slot_count <= 6
ORDER BY new_designs DESC, total_cents, first_quote COLLATE BINARY, second_quote COLLATE BINARY
LIMIT 1",
  "decision-paired-relief-shuttle-allocation": "SELECT c.order_id, x.offer_id AS first_offer, y.offer_id AS second_offer,
       MIN(c.waiting_a, (CASE WHEN x.stop_code = 'A' THEN x.seats ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN y.stop_code = 'A' THEN y.seats ELSE 0 END))
       + MIN(c.waiting_b, (CASE WHEN x.stop_code = 'B' THEN x.seats ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN y.stop_code = 'B' THEN y.seats ELSE 0 END)) AS carried,
       x.fee_cents + y.fee_cents AS cost_cents
FROM closure_order AS c
CROSS JOIN shuttle_offer AS x
JOIN shuttle_offer AS y ON x.offer_id COLLATE BINARY < y.offer_id AND x.pool_code <> y.pool_code
WHERE x.fee_cents + y.fee_cents <= c.cap_cents
ORDER BY carried DESC, cost_cents, first_offer COLLATE BINARY, second_offer COLLATE BINARY
LIMIT 1",
  "decision-park-trail-opening-portfolio": "WITH masks(selection_mask) AS (VALUES (1), (2), (3), (4), (5), (6), (7)),
site_work AS (
  SELECT m.selection_mask, t.site_id, SUM(t.gain) AS gain, s.prep_days + SUM(t.finish_days) AS days
  FROM masks AS m
  JOIN trail_option AS t ON (m.selection_mask & t.trail_bit) <> 0
  JOIN prep_site AS s ON s.site_id = t.site_id
  GROUP BY m.selection_mask, t.site_id, s.prep_days
)
SELECT selection_mask, SUM(gain) AS capacity_gain, SUM(days) AS crew_days
FROM site_work
GROUP BY selection_mask
HAVING SUM(days) <= 12
ORDER BY capacity_gain DESC, crew_days, selection_mask
LIMIT 1"
}

  SELECT b.window_id, b.rule_source, f.offer_source AS frame_source, p.offer_source AS panel_source,
         f.price_cents + p.price_cents + b.fee_cents * CASE WHEN f.carrier_code = p.carrier_code THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS delivered_cents
  FROM bay_addendum AS b
  JOIN lot_offer AS f ON f.lot_code = 'frame'
  JOIN lot_offer AS p ON p.lot_code = 'panel'
  WHERE f.pallet_qty + p.pallet_qty <= b.pallet_cap
), ranked AS (
  SELECT feasible.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY window_id ORDER BY delivered_cents, frame_source COLLATE BINARY, panel_source COLLATE BINARY) AS position
  FROM feasible
)
SELECT window_id, rule_source, frame_source, panel_source, delivered_cents
FROM ranked
WHERE position = 1
ORDER BY window_id COLLATE BINARY

WITH masks(selection_mask) AS (VALUES (1), (2), (3), (4), (5), (6), (7)),
site_work AS (
  SELECT m.selection_mask, t.site_id, SUM(t.gain) AS gain, s.prep_days + SUM(t.finish_days) AS days
